channel.title: Violations Watch: Iran
channel.description: New incidents reported in Iran. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Iran flogs a singer and four members of her production team, an Iranian website reports (Reuters)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Iran. Types: Torture & ill-treatment, Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: Iranian authorities. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1942

item.title: Revolutionary Court of Kashan sentences Moein (Mohieddin) Fallahian to more than 15 years in prison (HRANA)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Kashan, Iran. Types: Persecution & repression, Arbitrary detention & disappearance. Alleged perpetrator: Iranian judiciary. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1940

item.title: Iran: Supreme Court upholds death sentences for two protesters convicted in the 2022 Ekbatan case, VOA reports
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Tehran, Iran. Types: Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: Iranian judiciary. Disputed or caveats: Authorities accuse the men of killing a Basij member during the 2022 protests. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1423

item.title: Three Baluch civilians reportedly killed by Iranian security forces
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Near Zahedan, Sistan-Baluchestan, Iran. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Iranian security forces. Reported casualties: 3 killed. Disputed or caveats: Source: NCRI (opposition). 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0477

item.title: Iran tortured a 13-year-old boy before killing him at a protest, source says
item.description: Unverified lead (Low priority). Iran. Types: Torture & ill-treatment, Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Iranian security forces. Reported casualties: 1 killed. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. Disputed or caveats: Single source. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0286
